baseline.strict_rule: The same monitored vegetation class must be present in all three baseline years.

candidate_change.purpose: Sensitive screening layer retained for comparison and possible-change reporting.

permanent_change.rule: From the first permanent-change year, the pixel must remain Built Area or Bare Ground in every available subsequent annual map through 2025.
permanent_change.persistence_years: 2025 - CHANGE_YEAR + 1; switching between Built Area and Bare Ground is allowed.

provisional.rule: 2025 is provisional in this dataset, which ends in 2025; a later annual map is needed to test persistence.

portal_area_reporting.primary_metric: Strict permanent change area inside the user-drawn polygon.
portal_area_reporting.lga_role: Reference overlay and location identification only; LGA geometry is not used to calculate site change area.
portal_area_reporting.edge_pixels: Use polygon-raster intersection rather than blindly counting all edge pixels as full 10 m pixels.
portal_area_reporting.area_method: EPSG:3857 is not equal-area. Pixel count × 0.01 ha is approximate nominal raster area only. Compute polygon and clipped changed-pixel areas geodesically or in an appropriate projected CRS; handle fractional boundary pixels.
portal_area_reporting.end_state_note: Label FIRST_END_CLASS and FINAL_2025_CLASS distinctly; do not silently mix first and final end states.

interpretation: Permanent vegetation-to-Built/Bare conversion within the selected polygon. Attribution to mining, factory activity or an operator requires lease, site or field evidence. Persistence is observed through 2025, not a prediction of future land cover.
validation: Living Atlas LULC is Sentinel-2-derived. Another Sentinel-2 analysis is not required as independent validation. Field, inspection, photographic, drone or documentary evidence is reviewed separately; only authorized reviewers may verify submissions.
